name: crowdsec
title: CrowdSec
description: Intrusion detection from Traefik's access log with the CrowdSec community blocklists. DCS registers a Traefik bouncer so bans are enforced at the proxy, and posts every decision to Discord when a webhook is set.

variables.name: PORT_CROWDSEC
variables.label: Local API Port
variables.description: Port for the CrowdSec Local API (used by bouncers)

variables.name: ENABLE_TRAEFIK_BOUNCER
variables.label: Block at the proxy (Traefik bouncer)
variables.description: Registers a bouncer on the CrowdSec LAPI and puts the crowdsec-bouncer middleware in Traefik's chain, so banned IPs are refused before they reach any app. Needs the traefik template.

variables.name: DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL
variables.label: Discord webhook for alerts
variables.description: Every ban posts an embed to this channel; leave empty to use the server's DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL, or to send nothing
